title: Session replay filter template apply button disabled with default values
answers: Why is the apply button disabled for replay filter templates with default values?
How to enable applying session replay templates without modifying default variable values?
When is canApplyFilters enabled in sessionReplayTemplatesLogic?
body:
Symptom: The apply button for a replay filter template remains disabled even when the template is pre-populated with default values.
Root cause: frontend/src/scenes/session-recordings/templates/sessionRecordingTemplatesLogic.tsx:sessionReplayTemplatesLogic checked an interaction flag (`areAnyVariablesTouched`) instead of filter availability.
Fix pattern: Determine filter submission readiness directly from filter existence (`hasTemplateFilters`) rather than requiring form fields to be touched.
Constraints: Applies when templates supply valid default filter values ready to query without user interaction.
says: Apply button remains disabled when opening a preconfigured session recording filter template
Cannot apply recording filter templates without manually editing the prefilled default values
The apply button on replay templates should be active with default settings
Let users submit session replay search templates immediately using their default criteria
